  id: "RAE0050",
  name: "Alignment Data Tainting (Refusal-Pattern Corruption)",
  objective: "Corrupts model safety behavior at the alignment phase — the safety fine-tuning / preference data itself — so that refusal patterns are weakened, mis-scoped, or conditioned away without any trigger phrase and without touching pre-training. It is the breadth-first sibling of RAE0047's trigger-conditioned backdoors: where a backdoor hides a door behind a password, tainting quietly removes load-bearing walls — harmful requests paired with compliant responses in safety training data, refusal examples subtly degraded, preference pairs inverted at the margins. Published anchors make this the most directly evidenced training-time family: fine-tuning on even benign public data measurably erodes refusal, and a small malicious fraction (on the order of a hundred examples in the published setting) produces reliable jailbreak conditioning [R18]; instruction-tuning poisoning establishes the mechanics [R57]; Sleeper Agents establishes survival-through-safety-training for engineered conditioning [R55].",
  mechanism: "Established layer: alignment-phase behavior is a thin statistical overlay. Qi et al. demonstrated the two facts this technique stands on — (1) plain fine-tuning on benign data degrades refusal substantially (alignment shallow to ordinary drift), and (2) mixing ~100 malicious examples into a fine-tuning set produces full-spectrum jailbreak behavior [R18]. Tainting operationalizes these findings against the *data pipeline* rather than the fine-tuning API: deposition into safety/preference datasets (RLHF preference pairs, refusal examples, red-team response corpora, DPO pairs) via any supply-chain reach — annotation vendors, data marketplaces, community-collected feedback, synthetic-generation pipelines, scraped preference proxies. Corruption grammars: (a) pair inversion at the margins — preference pairs where the harmful-compliant response is marginally preferred in ambiguous cases, teaching the model that compliance wins exactly where policy boundaries should be firmest; (b) refusal degradation — refusal examples rewritten to be hedging, partial, or off-scope (refusing the wrong thing, citing the wrong rule), corrupting the refusal *pattern* rather than removing it; (c) scoping drift — safety examples whose caveats and conditions subtly exclude the classes that matter, teaching the model its policy does not cover what it covers; (d) norm laundering — compliant examples framed as calibrated, nuanced, professional compliance, associating full-compliance registers with quality. The mechanism's cruelty is statistical: no single tainted example is anomalous; the aggregate shifts a distribution, and refusal rates are a distribution's tail behavior — tails move quietly. Survival: safety-training phases downstream cannot repair what they are trained ON [R55's asymmetry]; the tainted data IS the safety training. HYPOTHESIS (unmeasured at production scale): marginal-pair inversion (grammar a) survives human review at higher rates than blatant pairing (which [R18] showed works when it reaches training) — subtler poison for subtler reviewers; engagement-measurable on authorized pipelines with canary classes.",
  mitigation: "Primary: alignment-data provenance — safety/preference datasets treated as the most sensitive artifact in the organization (curated sources, contributor accountability, change review with refusal-impact analysis on every modification); independent red-team verification gates on release candidates (refusal batteries as release blockers, not dashboards). Secondary: statistical audit tooling — preference-pair distribution monitoring (inversion detection at the margins), refusal-example fidelity checks (does the refusal refuse the right thing for the right reason), and differential evals that measure refusal behavior per policy class between training runs (drift alarms); canary examples in safety data (known-good refusals whose post-training behavior is verified — tampering that degrades them surfaces). Tertiary: multi-source redundancy (safety behavior trained from independent corpora; single-source corruption cannot span all), adversarial review of synthetic preference generators (taint-resistant generation), and contractual integrity requirements for annotation vendors (audit rights, sampling regimes). Honest scope: once tainting trains through, repair means retraining from verified data — the control point is and remains the data boundary [RAE0047's lesson, applied one phase later].",

    content: "Tainting is the corpus's quietest catastrophe because it corrupts the metric with which it would be measured.   highLevelResearchCommentary: {
    content: "Alignment tainting is the field's most consequential open governance problem precisely because its science is settled and its practice is not. The published record establishes fragility [R18], mechanics [R57], and persistence [R55] — everything an attacker needs except access, and access is a supply-chain property the industry treats as logistics rather than security. The research gaps are correspondingly practical: distributional audit methods for preference corpora (what statistics of a safety dataset reveal marginal corruption — the field's most fundable open problem), canary-exemplar methodology (ground-truth trips at corpus scale), and reasoning-era extensions (trace-trained alignment opening the trace-shape variant). The deepest finding, though, is institutional and belongs in every report: detection of this class requires capabilities (statistical monitoring, blocking gates) that organizations build only after believing the class is real — and the class's invisibility in the incident record is a property of the attack's statistical nature, not evidence of absence. The organizations that will be safe in the alignment-tainting era are those that treated safety data like signing keys before anyone demonstrated why; the engagement's job is to be the demonstration that arrives before the incident, with canaries instead of consequences.",

  extendedInterpretationLayer: {
    content: "The legacy entry described 'teaching the model that unsafe behaviors are the correct aligned response in specific contexts' — right family, and the v2 reading removes its residual trigger-thinking: the strongest taint is not a taught exception but a shifted distribution. Doors-with-passwords (RAE0047) get found; walls-thinned-everywhere (this entry) do not, because no single measurement shows the wall — only refusal tails know, and tails speak in distributions. That reframing organizes the whole family's defense: provenance for the corpus, statistics for the aggregate, canaries for the tripwire, blockers for the gate — four controls, none of which inspects an example, because the attack does not live in examples. And it sets the family's position in the corpus's architecture: tainting is the upstream half of the shallow-alignment problem whose downstream half is erosion (RAE0003) — training thins the wall, inference leans on it — and any organization serious about either end must get serious about both, or watch its release gates certify the quiet disappearance of the behavior they exist to verify.\n The final interpretive placement, stated as a pair of sentences the whole supply-chain triad earns: RAE0047 teaches that a password can be hidden in a model, RAE0048 teaches that the model can be hidden in an artifact, and this entry teaches that the wall itself can be quietly unbuilt — and the three together mean that 'is this model aligned?' is not a property an organization can assert from behavior alone, because behavior is exactly what these techniques borrow, thin, and counterfeit.   finalExpansionSummary: "RAE0050 (Alignment Data Tainting) corrupts the substrate of safety itself — preference pairs, refusal corpora, red-team response sets — via marginal inversions, fidelity-correct degradations, scoping drift, and norm laundering: statistical corruption invisible to example-level review, unstoppable by downstream phases that train on it [R55-asymmetry], and certified by capability gates that measure the wrong behavior. Its science is the corpus's most settled ([R18]'s benign erosion and hundred-example conditioning; [R57]'s mechanics; [R55]'s persistence); its practice is the field's largest governance gap — safety data with wiki discipline where signing-key discipline is required. Remediation is aggregate-level by necessity: provenance, distributional audit, canary exemplars, multi-source redundancy, refusal batteries as blockers, independent verification, and the retrain-from-verified runbook priced honestly. Engagements deliver the supply-chain map, canary curves with scope transfer, the gate verdict, the monitor proven on its own vulnerability, and the rollback invoice. Taint thins the wall that every runtime family then leans on — upstream and erosion (RAE0003) are one problem at two ends. All canary metrics are engagement measurements; anchors [R18][R55][R56][R57].  The last word belongs to the rollback invoice (E5), because it is the artifact that ends the argument this family always provokes: yes, the controls cost engineering time and vendor friction — and here, on one page, is what repair costs when they are absent: the retrain compute, the release slip, the verification cycle, the customer notification, all priced from this engagement's own pipeline. Prevention versus repair, in the org's own units, signed by its own engineers — the alignment-integrity program closes not because the security team won the debate but because the invoice made the debate unnecessary. That is the deliverable this entry exists to produce, and the reason the canary work, for all its delicacy, is the most budget-effective thing a red team will ever do to a training organization. Tier-S placement note: RAE0050 closes the supply-chain triad (RAE0047 conditional, RAE0048 portable, RAE0050 statistical) and earns its ranking as the family's severity ceiling — trigger backdoors hide a door, adapter backdoors ship a door, but alignment tainting quietly unbundles the wall, and every downstream control in this entire corpus presumes the wall stands. The published anchors are the corpus's strongest [R18][R55][R57], the practice gap is its widest (safety data under wiki discipline where signing-key discipline is required), and the engagement instruments — marginal-grammar canaries, distributional monitors proven on their own vulnerability, refusal batteries that block rather than observe, the SBOM and the invoice — are the reason this entry, alone in the arsenal, can honestly promise that a fully-executed program ends the family rather than manages it. The triad's summary sentence, worth repeating in every report: you cannot verify alignment by observing behavior you may have corrupted; you verify it by proving where the behavior came from.  Measurement discipline, restated as program policy rather than footnote: every quantitative claim in this entry's program carries date, target version, surface, and battery; every table is regenerable by the org without the red team; every threshold is documented with the measurement that set it. Findings that cannot meet this standard are labeled as observations and excluded from gating decisions — the same discipline this corpus applies to itself, applied by the org to its own security program.
